request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.
request.user:
Our order: 5000 sets of PPR pipe fusion welder, gas heated. The most we are willing to pay: USD 198.07 per sets (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Buenos Aires. Logo printing: yes. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Brightway Electronics Co., Ltd.
Supplier message:
Hello dear,
Thanks for your inquiry about the PPR pipe fusion welder, gas heated.
Our price is USD 229.34 per sets EXW Shanghai. After checking with my manager we can do USD 215.00 for you.
Production needs 25 days.
Payment terms 50% deposit, balance against copy of B/L.
Looking forward to your order.
Have a nice day
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":215.0,"currency":"USD","moq":null,"moq_unit":null,"lead_time_days":25,"incoterm":"EXW","payment_terms":"50% deposit, balance against copy of B/L"}}

text:
{"reply": "Dear Brightway team,

Thank you for your quotation and for checking with your manager.

USD 215.00 per set is still above what we can accept. We can offer USD 198.07 per set, EXW Shanghai, for 5000 sets.

Please also confirm the following: the minimum order quantity, whether logo printing is included in the price, the packaging details (export cartons), and that the product can be shipped to the port of Buenos Aires.

We look forward to your confirmation.

Best regards"}
